about_the_game:
It is year 256 of Shartemen. You are a champion of the Pilgrims, answering your mentor's call to arms against the marching Naga Cult. You and your unlikely friend will be sent into many battles against all sorts of foes, but the end goal is clear: Hunt down the Naga Cult's current masterminds. How are you going to win this struggle?

  • A simple 2D isometric combat game made in Construct 2 where you play as the best... or the worst, among your people.

  • Boss fights are the sole focus: Others already took care of the fodders when you enter the stage.

  • The Naga Cult has secured vast amount of territory. Claim it back with your every victory.

  • The goal is to win your fights, not necessarily to exterminate your targets. Some may appreciate mercy.

  • Do not drag this struggle for too long. The Naga Cult learn and improve from every defeat.

  • As a PILGRIM CHAMPION or as a FANG OF GABARA, you are each armed with 3 WEAPONS.

  • You start the game with just the two of you, but you might meet more on your path.

  • Do you have TWO GAMEPADS? Grab a friend with you for CO-OP GAMEPLAY!

  • 20+ BOSSES in the list to fight, because it's war!

  • Need more EQUIPMENT? See what you can CRAFT or BUY from your people and allies.

  • Pay attention to your RENOWN and WEEK COUNT!

  • 20+ BOSSES in the list to fight, because it's war!

  • Make your choice once victory is yours: Will you TAKE DOWN the target, or LET THEM LIVE?

  • Secrets and collectibles to find!

  • Try to discover all the ways to end your campaign.

  • Soundtracks, carefully crafted to depict a fantasy set in bronze age era where magic is as common as breathing and everything develops around the fact.

RECOMMENDED : Xbox or similar gamepad

short_description: The Naga Cult has started a new march! Join the fight against them! In this simple 2D isometric combat game where the focus lies in the boss fights, everyone expects you to show the Naga Cult why the Pilgrims named you their champion!
